name: spcx-personal-watch
purpose: Informational Friday check for LP personal SpaceX (SPCX) — capital preservation / when to consider exiting. NOT the Agentic fund book.
accountNote: Personal LP SPCX is outside Agentic. This automation never calls review_equity_order, place_equity_order, cancel_*, or sizes Agentic NAV.
goalNote: Primary objective is capital preservation (detect disconnection of price vs fundamentals and AI-cycle risk). Not maximizing upside.

schedule.description: Friday 6:00 PM ET — after Agentic weekly review (16:30) and calibration (17:00).

position.note: Update shares/avg cost here when the personal account changes. Automation does not pull personal brokerage lots.

baseCasePricePath.note: Recalculated 2026-08-14. Previous $160→$1200 path is NOT the base case. Too high from Q4 2026 onward.

extremeBull.equityNote: Musk $300–500B ARR scenario — not a forecast

capitalPreservationRules.primaryRule: Act on valuation vs fundamentals, never on price-up alone.
stopAddingIf: Price above bull band without GW/contracts/tenor evidence
Revenue per GW stays well below $10B/year while management repeats $30–50/W
90-day cloud termination risk materializes (churn or delayed $6.7B Oct pack)
considerTrimIf: Price in bull band AND AI still loss-making with 90-day contracts
Hyperscaler capex guides cut AND SPCX multiple still expanding
Price hits a listed level in sellFramework without matching fundamentals
thesisBrokenIf: Cloud contracts cancelled or concentrated customer exit
AI compute miss vs >2 GW YE2026 / closer-to-10-than-5 YE2027
Q3/Q4 2026 AI revenue fails Musk September crossover AND the $6.7B pack slips
Starlink operating income collapses (valuation floor gone)

160.holdIf: Q3 AI run-rate rising or IFT-14 progress
160.consider: Reassess early if hit before 2026-09-30; do not auto-sell

300.holdIf: 2027 GW >=6 and AI EBITDA approaching 0 or tenor >12 months

700.holdIf: ~$300B ARR visible in filings not slides
